accepted_claim: The universal expected normalized anchored p-th-moment comparison is false: at n=3,d=1,p=4, the continuous random generalized-lattice moment is 19/1620 > 4/405 = 16/1620 iid, with excess 1/540 and ratio 19/16.

scope.generator_and_shift: Independent continuous uniforms on [0,1)^d; replacing by the closed cube changes no expectation.
scope.point_definition: t_j={jz+Delta}, 0<=j<n, counted by index with weight 1/n.
scope.second_counterexample: n=4,d=1,p=4: lattice moment >= 2/315 > 11/1920 iid; lower-bound margin 5/8064.
scope.second_moment_equality: For all n,d, expected squared discrepancy = (2^(-d)-3^(-d))/n in both ensembles.
scope.small_point_counts: For n=1 and n=2, complete point-ensemble laws agree in all dimensions; three is the smallest possible counterexample point count.
scope.supplementary_n4_exact_value: 139/17280, confirmed by independent exact recomputation; not required for the analytic counterexample.
